title: This Centipede Hangs From a Cave Ceiling and Catches Bats

scenes.text: This centipede catches flying bats with its bare legs.
The giant centipede grows over thirty centimeters long, the length of your forearm.
In pitch-black caves it grips the ceiling with its back legs and dangles its front half into the air.
When a bat flies past, it snatches it mid-flight. The venom takes it down within seconds.
Then it eats the bat, still hanging upside down, for about an hour.

description:
The giant centipede, Scolopendra gigantea, can grab bats out of the air in dark caves.
It hangs from the ceiling, subdues them with venom, and eats them while hanging upside down.
Would you go into that cave?
first_comment: Is this the scariest predator in a cave? Tell us another.
